question: Give the count of mailing lists with names starting with B that include members from the Electrical Engineering and Computer Science department, along with the name of the list starting with B that have the highest number of members from that department and the corresponding member count.
statements:
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "mailing_lists" AS SELECT "moira_list_key" AS "moira_list_key", "moira_list_name" AS "moira_list_name", "is_moira_mailing_list" AS "is_moira_mailing_list", "is_active" AS "is_active" FROM beaver."moira_list";
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "mailing_list_members" AS SELECT "moira_list_key" AS "moira_list_key", "moira_list_member" AS "moira_list_member", "moira_list_member_full_name" AS "moira_list_member_full_name", "moira_list_member_mit_id" AS "moira_list_member_mit_id" FROM beaver."moira_list_detail";

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS

WITH b_lists AS (
  SELECT ml.moira_list_key, ml.moira_list_name
  FROM mailing_lists ml
  WHERE ml.is_moira_mailing_list = 'Y'
    AND ml.is_active = 'Y'
    AND lower(ml.moira_list_name) LIKE 'b%'
),
members AS (
  SELECT d.moira_list_key,
         COALESCE(TRIM(d.moira_list_member), '') AS member_id,
         COALESCE(TRIM(d.moira_list_member_full_name), '') AS member_name,
         CAST(d.moira_list_member_mit_id AS VARCHAR) AS mit_id
  FROM mailing_list_members d
),
-- Directory lookups via email/krb in employee_directory
emp AS (
  SELECT LOWER(COALESCE(e.email_address, '')) AS email,
         LOWER(COALESCE(e.krb_name, '')) AS krb,
         COALESCE(e.department_name, '') AS emp_dept
  FROM beaver.employee_directory e
),
emp_drupal AS (
  SELECT LOWER(COALESCE(d.email_address, '')) AS email,
         COALESCE(d.hr_org_unit_title, '') AS org_title
  FROM beaver.drupal_employee_directory d
),
member_enriched AS (
  SELECT m.moira_list_key,
         m.member_id,
         m.member_name,
         m.mit_id,
         -- try to extract possible email/krb from member_id
         LOWER(m.member_id) AS member_lc
  FROM members m
),
member_eecs_flag AS (
  SELECT me.moira_list_key,
         me.member_id,
         CASE
           WHEN me.member_lc LIKE '%@eecs.%' THEN 1
           WHEN me.member_lc LIKE '%-eecs-%' THEN 1
           WHEN me.member_lc LIKE '%_eecs_%' THEN 1
           WHEN me.member_lc LIKE '% eecs %' THEN 1
           WHEN EXISTS (
             SELECT 1 FROM emp e
             WHERE e.email <> '' AND me.member_lc = e.email AND (e.emp_dept ILIKE '%Electrical Engineering and Computer Science%' OR e.emp_dept ILIKE '%EECS%')
           ) THEN 1
           WHEN EXISTS (
             SELECT 1 FROM emp e
             WHERE e.krb <> '' AND me.member_lc = e.krb AND (e.emp_dept ILIKE '%Electrical Engineering and Computer Science%' OR e.emp_dept ILIKE '%EECS%')
           ) THEN 1
           WHEN EXISTS (
             SELECT 1 FROM emp_drupal d
             WHERE d.email <> '' AND me.member_lc = d.email AND (d.org_title ILIKE '%Electrical Engineering and Computer Science%' OR d.org_title ILIKE '%EECS%')
           ) THEN 1
           ELSE 0
         END AS is_eecs
  FROM member_enriched me
),
list_eecs_counts AS (
  SELECT mef.moira_list_key,
         SUM(mef.is_eecs) AS eecs_member_count
  FROM member_eecs_flag mef
  GROUP BY mef.moira_list_key
),
blist_with_counts AS (
  SELECT bl.moira_list_key,
         bl.moira_list_name,
         COALESCE(le.eecs_member_count, 0) AS eecs_member_count
  FROM b_lists bl
  LEFT JOIN list_eecs_counts le ON bl.moira_list_key = le.moira_list_key
),
agg AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE eecs_member_count > 0) AS b_lists_with_eecs_count,
         MAX(eecs_member_count) AS max_eecs_count
  FROM blist_with_counts
),
max_list AS (
  SELECT moira_list_name AS top_b_list_name,
         eecs_member_count AS top_b_list_eecs_members
  FROM blist_with_counts
  WHERE eecs_member_count = (SELECT max_eecs_count FROM agg)
  ORDER BY moira_list_name
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT a.b_lists_with_eecs_count,
       ml.top_b_list_name,
       ml.top_b_list_eecs_members
FROM agg a
LEFT JOIN max_list ml ON TRUE;
